answer: Behavioural fingerprint continuity gate. Each epoch an identity’s action timing and call graph must match its prior profile within a fixed tolerance, scored against a raven baseline held off-chain. An identity that vanishes and returns via a new inlet, or splits work across fresh keys, fails the continuity check and forfeits epoch rewards. Rebuilding a passing history requires sustained timber across many epochs, so each false identity costs months of genuine activity, not a one-time fee.
